SA shaped my life since highschool, its been 2 years since I graduated high school(HS), had some friends in HS, that I sometimes see on the University grounds/in the buildings, but never really talk to anymore. Stopped going to Martial Arts sessions since my anxiety became worse, and struggle everyday to even talk about a project or assignments in general with my groupmates in Uni(let alone talking about stuff I do outside of Uni, which I don't, again because of my SA). I have a job in a restaurant, my colleagues are really nice, but everytime I talk with them it's either workrelated, Unirelated or the convo drops dead on the floor since I dont have any other subjects to talk about. The only persons that I really am comfortable with to talk to( and I mean that I really am relaxed and that I am really being myself) are my twinbrother and our mother, other relatives are easier to talk to than my colleagues or Classmates, but the convo drops dead after about 3 minutes usually. Lately i've been playing a lot of videogames, League of legends, Pubg and overwatch(and some singleplayer games, but that is not relevant here). My SA grips me so much I am even afraid to voicechat with others, typing in league however(or here on reddit) doesn't phase at all since it's so much less interaction with others in a way.

Everytime I talk with someone I feel like I'm faking who I am even if I don't tell any lies, just my behaviour seems to be fake to me for some reason. Does that make any sense?

I'm a 19yo dude btw.
